texts.tap: Please tap the screen and share the live!
texts.welcome: Welcome to the live! It is lovely to have you here.
texts.country: Write your country in the comments, and select a car!
texts.hearts: Please send hearts, everybody! Let us keep the energy going!
texts.keepTapping: Keep tapping! Every ten likes gives your car one helping point.
texts.gifts: Support your driver! Send the gift shown above your car to help it move.
texts.cheer: Come on, team! Keep supporting your driver. This race is getting exciting!
texts.share: Invite your friends, share the live, and join the fun!
texts.race: Choose your car, support your driver, and enjoy the race!
texts.winner: Congratulations to our winner! What an amazing race! Well done, and thank you everyone for your support!
texts.likeThanks: Over one thousand likes! Thank you so much for tapping and supporting the race!
